verdict.rationale: `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` previews changes before the second command writes the selected skill files into the project. Those files can be committed and shared, which means they are ordinary local files that can be read and reviewed in full after installation. Missing for 10: detail on what the dry-run preview shows (file list vs. full file contents), any mention of scripts as opposed to instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
